Short title and commencement

THE PUBLIC GAMBLING (REPEAL) ACT
THE PUBLIC GAMBLING (REPEAL) ACT
(II OF 1985)
[7th November,
1985]
An Act to repeal the Public Gambling Act, 1867
1. Short title, and commencement: (1) This Act shall be called the
Public Gambling (Repeal) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Repeal of Act, III of 1867

THE PUBLIC GAMBLING (REPEAL) ACT
THE PUBLIC GAMBLING (REPEAL) ACT
(II OF 1985)
[7th November,
1985]
An Act to repeal the Public Gambling Act, 1867
2. Repeal of Act, III
of 1867 : The Public Gambling Act, 1867 (III of 1867) is hereby repealed.
